name: Tiffany Greens Golf Club
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from golfify, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Gold, Blue. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: geometry safe: pars, routing, greens and tee positions are right on all 18 holes for the yardages the page states, and qa_page.js finds 0 problems.

1: Routing, green, par 5 OK. Page Gold tee is a lidar pad under trees ~25 yds behind the Blue box (18 yds from the nearest OSM box; 514 vs card 510), plausible for a back tee but unconfirmed.
